title: Spectral Thresholds in Correlated Spiked Models and Fundamental Limits of Partial Least Squares
abstract: arXiv:2510.17561v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We provide a rigorous random matrix theory analysis of spiked cross-covariance models where the signals across two high-dimensional data channels are partially aligned. These models are motivated by multi-modal learning and form the standard generative setting underlying Partial Least Squares (PLS), a widely used yet theoretically underdeveloped method. We show that the leading singular values of the sample cross-covariance matrix undergo a Baik-Ben Arous-Peche (BBP)-type phase transition, and we characterize the precise thresholds for the emergence of informative components. Our results yield the first sharp asymptotic description of the signal recovery capabilities of PLS in this setting, revealing a fundamental performance gap between PLS and the Bayes-optimal estimator. translated_title: 相关尖峰模型中的谱阈值与偏最小二乘法的基本极限
translated_abstract: 我们对尖峰互协方差模型提供了严格的随机矩阵理论分析，该模型中两个高维数据通道之间的信号是部分对齐的。这些模型的动机来自多模态学习，并构成了偏最小二乘法（PLS）——一种被广泛使用但理论研究不足的方法——背后的标准生成设定。我们证明了样本互协方差矩阵的领先奇异值会经历Baik-Ben Arous-Péché（BBP）型相变，并刻画了信息性成分出现的精确阈值。我们的结果首次对PLS在此设定下的信号恢复能力给出了精确的渐近描述，揭示了PLS与贝叶斯最优估计器之间的根本性能差距。特别地，我们识别出信噪比（SNR）和相关性所在的区间：尽管信号在原则上是可以被检测到的，但PLS在这些区间内却无法恢复任何信号。
tldr: 本文利用随机矩阵理论证明了部分对齐的尖峰互协方差模型中样本奇异值会经历BBP型相变，首次精确刻画了偏最小二乘法（PLS）的信号恢复能力，并揭示了PLS与贝叶斯最优估计器之间的根本性能差距，指出在某些信噪比和相关性区间内PLS会完全无法恢复信号。
en_tdlr: This paper rigorously proves via random matrix theory that the leading singular values of sample cross-covariance matrices in correlated spiked models undergo a BBP-type phase transition, provides the first sharp asymptotic characterization of Partial Least Squares (PLS) signal recovery, and reveals a fundamental performance gap between PLS and the Bayes-optimal estimator, identifying SNR and correlation regimes where PLS fails to recover any signal despite theoretical detectability.
